name: ai-model-web
description: Use this skill when a browser/Web app (React, Vue, Next, Nuxt, static sites, SPAs, dashboards, AI chat UI, 页面, 前端, 网页) needs AI models via @cloudbase/js-sdk. Default routing for Web/frontend AI — call directly from the browser, do NOT propose a Node.js proxy. Covers generateText and streamText; models via ai.createModel with groups cloudbase, hunyuan-exp, or custom-*, model id in the `model` field. MUST run two-step preflight before code — see body. NOT for Node.js backend (use ai-model-nodejs),
author: TencentCloudBase
summary_zh: 面向网页和前端应用的 AI 模型调用方案，可通过 CloudBase SDK 在浏览器中直接实现文本生成与流式对话。
